messages:
luis: Heads up — we're getting repeated 'pager delivery failed' spikes from notify-orch. Customers reporting pages didn't arrive in the last 10m. Sentry shows downstream 502/504s.

tom: Confirming. I see a few suppressed posts in #incidents: 'alert suppressed by policy' but no one changed policies.

sre-bot: automated: notify-orchestrator: delivery_report: 502 gateway_error x 87 in 10m for service=pager-relay

eva: Quick repro: `curl -v https://notify.internal/v1/send` returns 200 but logs show `POST https://pager-relay/... -> 504` and retries.

ops-oncall: I'm the active oncall and didn't receive any page for the cluster alerts. Manual test page also didn't reach my phone a minute ago.

mike: We rolled out notify-orch v2.14 18m ago. Any signing/key rotation around then? We had a key rotation job earlier today.

luis: Pagerflow signing key rotated ~2h ago. Secrets look present in k8s, but headers on the relay look truncated in the proxy logs (Header-Length mismatch).

tom: Possible proxy truncation. Quick mitigation: flip notify-proxy to fallback routing. `kubectl -n notify set env deploy/notify-proxy USE_FALLBACK=true` — someone run if you have perms.

eva: Done. Fallback routing enabled on one replica, sending test pages now.

ops-oncall: Test page came through on fallback. I just got the SMS and call. Manual paging (via `tools/manual-escalate`) also worked.

luis: So main path is failing (header truncation -> signature mismatch -> relay rejects). Fallback avoids the problematic header rewrite. Patch the proxy config to preserve long headers.

mike: Rolling a quick config patch to disable header folding and bumping proxy buffer sizes. Will push a canary to one zone.

tom: I've started incident ticket INC-2026-03-17-001 and tagged infra/sre. Customers impacted: 12 orgs had delayed phone/SMS pages, no product downtime but delayed on-call response. Need comms plan.

eva: Added short-term observability: graph of paging success rate, and alert if delivery <95% for 5m. Will keep watching.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: I'm back oncall and monitoring. If pages stop, we'll revert to full manual escalation.

sre-bot: automated: incident created INC-2026-03-17-001, severity=low-medium, assignees=[ops-oncall, mikes], links=[sentry,graph]

tom: Postmortem owners assigned. We'll include root cause (proxy header truncation after config change), mitigation (fallback + proxy buffer fix), and next steps (add e2e paging test + signing key validation).
